about_short_description.short_description: Coactive AI is a machine learning platform that unlocks analytics and insights from unstructured image and video data.

product.name: Multimodal Application Platform (MAP)
product.description: A platform that enables search, organization, and analysis of images, video, and audio using multimodal AI without requiring metadata or tags.

product.name: Visual AI Search
product.description: An AI-powered search tool that allows users to find images and videos using natural language queries without relying on existing metadata.

product.name: Metadata Tagging and Enrichment
product.description: Automated generation and enrichment of metadata for images and videos using AI to improve content organization and discovery.

product.name: Multimodal Video Analytics
product.description: Advanced analytics that combine video, image, and audio data to extract insights and measure content performance.
